name: kinlace
description: Kinlace Parent Recap: a nightly Brief of your kids' school and club news, in your language

plugins.name: parent-recap
plugins.description: Every evening, summarizes your kids' school mail, Wilma, WhatsApp parent groups and MyClub into a Brief in your language sent to your inbox, with optional Weekend Picks. On a Mac or a Windows 11 PC; WhatsApp and writing to Google Calendar are Mac only.
